validations.message: Per-milestone consideration recomputes: 2,000,000/6,000,000/2,000,000 CC x 0.0033 USD = 6,600/19,800/6,600; total 33,000 USD ties to 10,000,000 CC x 0.0033.
Arrangement characterization (noncash consideration for services vs grant) requires technical-accounting review.
Measurement-date judgment (each milestone approval/mint vs inception) requires technical-accounting review; drives both timing and amount.
Consideration amount depends on the referenced ASC 820 per-coin fair value (0.0033 USD/CC, Level 3), whose own judgment is reviewRequired. This package inherits that review status.
